channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Two siblings killed in fire at old residential quarters in Arunachal’s Tezu
item.description: The incident marks the town’s second major fire in a month after a November blaze gutted seven hostel rooms

item.title: Policy changes needed urgently to save Indian aviation sector: Pilots’ federation
item.description: Federation of Indian Pilots president Capt CS Randhawa warns that high fuel costs, airport privatisation and Indigo’s dominance are pushing India’s aviation sector into crisis.

item.title: New Delhi flags security risk after anti-India protest near High Commission in Dhaka
item.description: Police stopped anti-India protesters as India raised concerns over mission security and Bangladesh’s deteriorating law-and-order situation.

item.title: NFR boosts passenger comfort with upgraded retiring rooms at Guwahati Railway Station
item.description: Northeast Frontier Railway has modernised dormitory and retiring rooms at Guwahati station, while boosting non-fare revenue with zero maintenance cost.

item.title: Four dead, several injured as chimney collapses at brick factory in Tripura
item.description: The chimney collapsed at ABC Brick Industry in Tripura’s Dhalai district, rescue operations are underway, and authorities are investigating safety compliance.

item.title: Sikkim opens Doklam & Cho La border areas to tourists under regulated access
item.description: Sikkim allows tourists to visit the border sites for the first time under regulated guidelines, aiming to boost border tourism and local livelihoods

item.title: Thuruk village emerges as offbeat winter paradise in Dima Hasao
item.description: Thuruk, tucked deep inside the Borail range, turns into a frosty wonderland between December and January.

item.title: Jonbeel Mela to kick off from January 22 to 24 in Morigaon
item.description: The fair will be organised in the traditional manner, bearing the mark of lasting peace, and the barter system employed in the Mela.

item.title: AJP sounds poll bugle for 2026, pushes for opposition unity to defeat BJP
item.description: At its fifth foundation day in Sadiya, the Assam Jatiya Parishad launched its poll campaign and vowing Opposition unity to prevent vote division

item.title: Karbi Anglong administration orders deportation of four declared foreigners
item.description: The Karbi Anglong district administration has issued deportation orders, irecting them to leave Assam and India within 24 hours or face forced removal.
